children: Moonshot AI said it has reported online rumors about its founder and employees to police and will pursue legal action, after claims circulated that the company’s founder had been taken away. According to BeInCrypto, the dispute follows Anthropic’s accusation that Moonshot quietly routed Kimi users’ questions to Claude and presented Claude’s answers as Kimi’s own work. Moonshot has not confirmed any arrest or investigation.

title: Moonshot AI Files Police Reports After Kimi K3 Rumors
